brief: The provinces around you have no master. Take land, gather resources, build your first factories: this is your first empire.
The neighbouring powers have woken up. Enemy scouts on the passes and a first fortification: watch your borders.
The Corruption has hardened the people here. Enemy artillery and engineers, deeper trenches: you need better weapons.
Here the Lumen drives the tanks. Enemy armour and fortifications everywhere: without an advanced Arsenal there is no way through.
The Signal is deafening. The powers fight as if the Advent were tomorrow: only a complete HQ will hold.
The sky is opening. Whoever holds the world now will answer for everyone.
